description: Search live campervan and motorhome hire availability and prices for an Australian pickup city and travel dates (pickup_date and dropoff_date in YYYY-MM-DD format). This is vehicle rental; search_campsites finds places to stay. Returns matching vehicles with brand, name, category, sleeps and seats, 4WD, nightly and total price in AUD, and a booking_url where the hire is completed on the rental partner's website. Australia only.

dropoff_date.description: Drop-off date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after pickup_date.
